# GetFreeToolsAI

> Free online tools for PDF, images, AI writing and more. Every tool runs 100% in your browser — files are never uploaded to a server. Free forever, browser-based, private processing, no watermark, no signup, no limits.

GetFreeToolsAI (https://www.getfreetoolsai.com) is a collection of fast, private, browser-based utilities. All processing happens on the user's device using WebAssembly and JavaScript; nothing is uploaded. There are no accounts, no daily limits, and no watermarks on any output.

## Key facts
- Free forever — no premium tier, no credit card.
- Browser-based — runs locally on the user's device.
- Private processing — files never leave the browser.
- No watermark — clean output on every tool.
- No signup — open any tool and start immediately.

- PNG to PDF: https://www.getfreetoolsai.com/pdf/png-to-pdf
- Unlock PDF: https://www.getfreetoolsai.com/pdf/unlock
- Rotate PDF: https://www.getfreetoolsai.com/pdf/rotate
- PDF to Word: https://www.getfreetoolsai.com/pdf/pdf-to-word
- Word to PDF: https://www.getfreetoolsai.com/pdf/word-to-pdf
- PDF OCR: https://www.getfreetoolsai.com/pdf/ocr
- Add Page Numbers to PDF: https://www.getfreetoolsai.com/pdf/number-pages
- Add Watermark to PDF: https://www.getfreetoolsai.com/pdf/watermark
